title: Security Audit Report
description: Structured output for a security audit or vulnerability assessment.

target.description: Component, PR, or service being audited.

exploit_path.description: Concrete attack path from entry point to impact.

blast_radius.description: Assets, tenants, and systems reachable if exploited.

ai_prompt_injection_check.description: True if the system was audited for prompt injection and jailbreak vulnerabilities.

sbom_verification.description: True if the Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) was verified for supply-chain integrity.

owasp_baseline.description: OWASP Top 10 edition the audit was performed against; 2025 is the current edition.

asi_review.description: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 coverage when agentic AI is in scope.

mcp_servers_pinned.description: True if every integrated MCP server is pinned to an immutable version hash.

max_blast_radius.description: Worst-case combined blast radius across all agent-reachable tools.

pqc_readiness.description: Post-quantum cryptography readiness (NIST IR 8547: deprecated 2030, disallowed 2035).

crypto_inventory_present.description: True if a CBOM (CycloneDX 1.6) crypto inventory exists for in-scope systems.

hybrid_tls_enabled.description: True if server-side TLS termination supports hybrid X25519MLKEM768.

migration_plan_present.description: True if a documented migration path off quantum-vulnerable crypto exists for long-lived data.

cra_compliance.description: EU Cyber Resilience Act readiness for products in EU scope.

in_scope.description: True if the audited product falls under EU CRA obligations.

reporting_process_active.description: True if the 24-hour ENISA/CSIRT vulnerability and incident reporting runbook is live (obligation since 2026-09-11).

support_period_months.description: Declared security support period in months; CRA requires >= 60 or product lifetime.

sbom_ready.description: True if a machine-readable SBOM pipeline produces release evidence (full obligation 2027-12-11).

findings.description: weather-tools MCP server is referenced by mutable tag; a rug-pull update would silently redefine tool schemas.
findings.remediation: Pin to an immutable version hash and alert on schema drift.
findings.exploit_path: registry push -> silent tool redefinition -> ASI02 tool misuse

asi_review.max_blast_radius: customer PII read + outbound email dispatch
